fields.label: GitHub App
fields.description: Create a GitHub App (Settings > Developer settings > GitHub Apps) with Repository permissions Contents: Read-only and Metadata: Read-only, the Push and Installation events, Setup URL / Callback URL https://<control-plane>/api/method/nexaploy.api.github.installation_callback and Webhook URL https://<control-plane>/api/method/nexaploy.api.github.webhook. Enable 'Request user authorization (OAuth) during installation'.

fields.label: App ID
fields.description: Numeric App ID (used as the JWT issuer).

fields.label: App Slug
fields.description: From https://github.com/apps/<slug>; used for the install link.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: Used to verify that the installing user can access the installation (OAuth code exchange).

fields.label: Private Key (PEM)
fields.description: Contents of the .pem private key file generated for the GitHub App.

fields.label: Webhook Secret
fields.description: Same value as the App's webhook secret; push events are rejected without a valid X-Hub-Signature-256.
